column1: # Readings the prefix-grammar checker rejects but a person judged real (2026-11-22): a whole word spelled out then abbreviated (המגידז"ל = המגיד זכרונו לברכה),
# numeral words (ע' = שבעים). The old checker passed them only through an invalid prefix split. Reviewed one by one from the 155 readings that flipped;
# the ~50 judged wrong or doubtful are not listed. Loaded by checker.load_irregular together with irregular.tsv (which make_irregular.py regenerates).
